notes: Shopify store (theme 'Prestige'). No Claude-specific robots.txt disallow (Allow: / for User-agent: *); accessed via direct HTTP fetch of collections.json (full enumeration, 3 pages, 663 collections total) plus each candidate collection's rendered page and public products.json endpoint (paginated to true end - collections.json's own products_count field proved inflated vs. actual products.json enumeration on every collection checked, consistent with known Shopify unreliability, so qty below is the real enumerated count, not the products_count field). No dedicated Christmas/Noel nav branch is currently live in main nav (checked full mega-menu link dump, all /collections/* hrefs) - this is expected in early September; the seasonal collections still exist and are publicly reachable (HTTP 200) with real, currently-listed products, discovered via collections.json rather than nav, per shared core's multiple-discovery-path allowance. No single unifying 'Noel'/'Christmas' parent page exists (checked /collections/noel, /collections/christmas, etc., all 404) so no grouping row was created - all rows are independent leaf PLPs. Excluded as false positives after inspection: 'wild-christmas' handle/collection (title 'Stay Wild', description is a leopard-print/western decor theme with zero Christmas content - handle is coincidental, not evidence); 'secret-santa' handle (page now retitled 'Entre amis' / generic small-gifts-for-any-occasion, no longer Christmas-specific); 'new-year' handle (title says 'New Year' but the actual product list is mugs/shelving/puzzle mats with 2023-2024 creation dates and zero festive content - this is a mislabeled general merchandise bucket, not the New Year's holiday, confirmed by full product sampling); 'hiver'/'essentiels-de-lhiver' ('Baby it's cold outside' / 'Winter Essentials' - generic cold-weather cocooning/comfort merchandising, not tied to a calendar occasion, of a kind with this store's many other unrelated lifestyle-themed collections e.g. Cocooning/Boho Vibes/Color Therapy); 'eclats-de-fete', 'place-a-la-fete', 'gift-set' (Coffrets de Fete) - generic 'celebration/gathering' collections with no specific holiday named in title or description; 'glitter-dinner' (Diners de fetes) - description only ties to New Year via a stale 'bye-bye 2023' phrase and its product mix (puzzles, cookbooks, disposable camera) is generic hosting/dinner-party merchandise, not specifically festive - excluded as too weak/stale an association. Kept 'nouvel-an' (New Year) after confirming its product list is genuinely party/NYE-themed (champagne flutes, wine glasses, 'Cadeau Mystere - Apero Party 2025', candles, trays). Overlap check performed on close-looking pairs (new-year vs nouvel-an, the two Valentine's collections, the two Mother's Day collections, hiver vs essentiels-de-lhiver) - all had low/no shared product IDs and different counts, so none are duplicates under the shared overlap rule; kept as distinct sibling sub-categories where included.
